name: Vendor quote comparison
summary: Before anyone signs, the person choosing a vendor gets one sheet: the criteria agreed first, every quote costed the same way, and each vendor eliminated with its reason, on hold with the question that settles it, or shortlisted with its trade-offs. A person chooses; contract terms go to your reviewer.

sources.title: The three rounds of elimination with one standing and one reason per vendor, the on-hold rule for a quote silent on a must-have, the recorded change of criteria, contract terms quoted for a reviewer without interpretation, and the rule that a person chooses, written for this template.

sources.contribution: Opening with the purchase itself, the reason for it, the money available and how long the business will be tied in; total cost over the commitment rather than the first price; evidence from the quote behind every judgment; calling out quotes that are not like for like and unanswered questions; promises outside the written quote not counted; renewal and exit terms drawn out; and not buying now as a legitimate outcome.

Criteria and the lines that rule an option out settled before options are assessed; options over a budget ceiling removed from the decision but kept visible; recurring costs counted over a fixed period; setting aside an option another matches or beats on every measure at no higher cost; and gaps and caveats kept on the record.
